article.title: Nepal flooding: an unnatural catastrophe
article.author: Editor
article.content: The collapse of a Himalayan glacier wreaked death and destruction as it cascaded down the valley. Feyzi Ismail explains why this is a result of climate crisis denial. The post Nepal flooding: an unnatural catastrophe appeared first on MR Online .
